name: rerun-bench
description: Replay a repo's own past bug-fix commits (or a bundled suite) N times per agent and measure how consistent it is: pass rate, pass^k, flip rate and cost spread.

interface.longDescription: rerun-bench measures how consistent a coding agent is across repeated runs. `mine` builds tasks from a repo's own past bug-fix commits and replays them against the agent, leading with the flip: which of your own fixes the agent reproduces reliably and which it flakes on. Or run the bundled suite N times per agent (Codex, Claude Code, opencode, or a free mock agent). It reports pass rate with a 95% interval, pass^k (all k runs pass), flip rate (two runs disagree) and cost spread; pass or fail is decided only by each task's hidden verifier. Real agent runs spend your quota and ask for confirmation first; start with the mock agent. Requires uv, git and Python 3.11+.
capabilities: Mines replayable bug-fix commits from a repo's git history
Replays the agent N times per task and leads with the flip
Reports pass rate, pass^k, flip rate and cost spread
defaultPrompt: Mine my repo's past bug fixes and replay them against my agent
Does Codex reproduce my own bug fixes consistently?
Run rerun-bench with the mock agent and summarize the report
